title: Initial configuration of the round body
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, let $start$ be one of its states, and let $w$ be a Boolean word. The round body's initial configuration on input $w$ is the configuration in its anchor state with all work tapes blank, all work-tape heads at position $0$, input head at position $1$, and empty output.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet
replaced:
On every input $w$, the initial configuration of the round body equals the
canonical anchored configuration whose stored words carry the empty
candidate.
